svg.title: Hanpu Li — faithful ink mark
svg.desc: Continuous Bézier outlines traced from the original bitmap. Original charcoal and crimson ink texture is retained; pinholes are transparent. The paper texture is a separate removable layer in the layered master. In dark mode, the ink palette adapts to the existing website colours #e8e4dc and #cf765e, without changing the source geometry or grain masks.
